_meta.description: Curated 'learn more' articles per green tag — real, current sources on global impact a shopper can affect. Static (not live-fetched). Keys match the canonical tags in server/utils/greenTags.js.

organic.title: Benefits of Organic
organic.summary: How organic farming reduces toxic pesticides, protects water quality, and builds biodiversity.

organic.title: The Environmental Benefits of Going Organic
organic.summary: Organic farms support ~30% more species and cut water contamination by up to 75% vs conventional.

plastic-packaging.title: The FoodPrint of Food Packaging
plastic-packaging.summary: How food packaging drives waste and pollution — packaging is ~28% of US municipal waste.

plastic-packaging.title: The Plastic Problem: How Food Packaging Impacts the Environment
plastic-packaging.summary: ~8M metric tons of plastic enter the oceans yearly; single-use food packaging is a top contributor.

recyclable-packaging.title: The FoodPrint of Food Packaging
recyclable-packaging.summary: Why choosing recyclable/renewable packaging (glass, cardboard) diverts waste from landfills.

plant-based.title: Your Guide to Climate Action: Food
plant-based.summary: The UN's guide to how food choices — especially eating more plants — cut personal emissions.

plant-based.title: Swapping Meat and Dairy for Plant-Based Foods Cuts Climate Pollution by 35%
plant-based.summary: A clinical trial: shifting to plant-based cut diet emissions ~35% (≈600 fewer miles driven/yr).

fair-trade.title: Fair Trade & The Environment: Protecting the Planet
fair-trade.summary: Certified farms ban deforestation and harmful pesticides while supporting farmer livelihoods.

fair-trade.title: Does Fairtrade Really Work?
fair-trade.summary: A balanced look at how Fairtrade certification helps (and its limits) for farming communities.

sustainable-seafood.title: Sustainable Seafood — Marine Stewardship Council
sustainable-seafood.summary: How the MSC blue-tick label and consumer choices help end overfishing and protect oceans.

sustainable-seafood.title: Buy Sustainable Seafood
sustainable-seafood.summary: A shopper's guide to seafood choices that reduce pressure on overfished stocks.
